# BrainWorks

> BrainWorks provides neurodevelopment services and brain training programs for children with learning and developmental disorders, specializing in primitive reflex assessment and integration.

BrainWorks is founded by Dr. Mary McKone and Dr. Angela Zielinski (DPT, Ed.D.) and offers comprehensive services including neurofeedback, listening therapy, consultation for educators, and professional training in reflex integration and sensory processing. The organization combines evidence-based neurodevelopmental approaches with practical programs for children, families, and educators.

## Key Topics

- Primitive Reflexes
- Neurodevelopment
- Learning Disabilities
- ADHD
- Dyslexia
- Sensory Integration

- Interactive Metronome
- Emotional Regulation
- Speech Disorders
- Sensory Processing

## Core Services

- [Services](https://www.brain-works.org/services): BrainWorks core services: primitive reflex assessment, neurodevelopment, remote programs.
- [Brain Training](https://www.brain-works.org/services-7): Brain training programs: neurofeedback, listening therapy, attention, executive functioning.
- [Consultation Services](https://www.brain-works.org/consultation-svcs): Consultation services for teachers: literacy curriculum, ADHD, dyslexia, trauma-informed approaches.

## Primitive Reflex Education

- [Primitive Reflexes](https://www.brain-works.org/primitive-reflexes): Educational guide on primitive reflex patterns and their role in child brain development.
- [Moro and Fear Paralysis Reflexes](https://www.brain-works.org/moro-and-fear-paralysis): Guide to Moro and Fear Paralysis reflexes: stress response, trauma effects, infant development.
- [ATNR Reflex](https://www.brain-works.org/atnr): ATNR reflex guide: infant development, midline crossing, dyslexia, auditory processing.

- [Events](https://www.brain-works.org/events): Upcoming trainings and professional courses: RMTi, reflex patterns, sensory integration.
